s1.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images
Thickening of the sphenoid sinus mucosa
Nodular lesion in the left lung field on chest CT

raw.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe

Thickening of the sphenoid sinus mucosa
Nodular lesion in the left lung field on chest CT

shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 levels and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and inflammation suggested by MRI and laboratory findings

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and thickening of the sphenoid sinus mucosa

shortlist.label: Pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: 7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic involvement suggested by nodular lesion in the left lung field and elevated IgG4 levels

raw.rationale: Elevated IgG4 levels, diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk, and thickening of the sphenoid sinus mucosa, along with a nodular lesion in the left lung field, are consistent with IgG4-related disease, which can cause hypophysitis.

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: No specific evidence of lymphocytic infiltration is mentioned

rejected.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
rejected.why: No granulomatous changes are described in the imaging findings

rejected.label: Pituitary adenoma
rejected.why: The 7-mm mass is poorly enhancing and not typical of a pituitary adenoma, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with hypophysitis

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: No other systemic evidence of sarcoidosis is mentioned, such as skin or eye involvement, and the elevated IgG4 levels point more towards IgG4-related disease
